title: Planned NBN maintenance – Ryde, Campsie, Glebe and Miranda areas (NSW)
current_summary: A network provider will carry out planned cable and splice relocation work that may affect NBN services connected through the Ryde, Campsie, Glebe and Miranda points of interconnect in NSW. The work is now scheduled between 11:00 pm on Thursday 21 January 2027 and 7:00 am on Friday 22 January 2027 (AEDT). Services may be interrupted for up to 8 hours during this window.

cause.reason: Planned cable and splice relocation work by a network provider.

updates.content: We have been advised that a network provider will be performing cable and splice relocation work that may affect NBN services connected through the Ryde, Campsie, Glebe and Miranda points of interconnect in NSW. The work is scheduled between 11:00 pm on Monday 2 November 2026 and 7:00 am on Tuesday 3 November 2026 (AEDT). Affected NBN services may be interrupted for up to 8 hours during this window. We will share any further updates as they become available.

The planned maintenance has been rescheduled. It will now take place between 11:00 pm on Thursday 21 January 2027 and 7:00 am on Friday 22 January 2027 (AEDT), instead of the previously advised 2 November 2026 window. Affected NBN services may still be interrupted for up to 8 hours during this window. We will share any further updates as they become available.
